# From Hella to Hyphy

> From Hella to Hyphy: The Bay Area Slang Dictionary is a 334-page reference book by Eryc Fields, published by FirstClass Media. It defines 803 Bay Area slang terms, documenting the language and hyphy culture of Northern California (Oakland, San Francisco, Vallejo, San Jose) with definitions and cultural context. ISBN 9798993317809.

## About

- Author: Eryc Fields, Bay Area author and speaker on Bay Area language and culture. Available for workshops, panels, podcasts and keynotes.
- Publisher: [FirstClass Media](https://firstclassmediagroup.com/)
- Family edition: From Hecka to Hyphy (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GMY94LZ4)
